purpose: Manual QA fixture for validating the macOS Accessibility provider on real macOS hardware without depending on unfinished Core runtime code.

scenarios.description: Validates list apps/windows and AX tree read against Finder. This is low-risk and should not mutate app state.
preconditions: Accessibility permission granted to the launching terminal/helper
Swift daemon can be built or started by DarwinHelper
failureHints: If read-ax-tree fails with permission errors, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility and grant the launching app.
If elementCount is 0, make a Finder window visible and retry, or test a simpler app such as TextEdit.

scenarios.description: Validates AX selector matching. Finder toolbar buttons vary by locale, so this is an example to adapt after inspecting firstActionable from the read-only report.

selectorResult.found: true when Finder exposes at least one AXButton

scenarios.description: Validates AXSetValue/background typing path and post-action AX value verification in a low-risk TextEdit scratch document.
preconditions: Open TextEdit with a new plain/rich text scratch document
Do not use a document containing important unsaved data
scenarios.command: node dist/scripts/macos-computer-use-verify.js --processName TextEdit --run-actions --setvalue-selector-json '{"AXRole":"AXTextArea"}' --text 'SpectrAI macOS AX verification'

expected.verification: ax-value success when AXValue is readable and settable

failureHints: If method is daemon.hidType, the text field did not expose settable AXValue; ensure TextEdit document is frontmost and editable.
If verification fails but text appears visually, Screen Recording fallback may be needed for visual verification.

scenarios.description: Validates System Events/JXA Automation path for menu selection. This intentionally changes foreground state and may open a Finder window.
preconditions: Automation permission is allowed when prompted for osascript/System Events controlling Finder
Finder is safe to bring foreground
scenarios.command: osascript -l JavaScript src/scripts/macos-ax-smoke.jxa --op selectMenu --processName Finder --menuPath '["File","New Finder Window"]'

warningsContains: menu selection requires foreground menu bar + Automation permission

failureHints: If error mentions not authorized, grant Automation for the launching app and System Events/Finder target.
If menu item name differs by locale, use a localized menuPath.

scenarios.description: Confirms capability report can expose missing Screen Recording before relying on visual/OCR fallback.

expected.ifMissing: read AX may pass, but screenshot/vision fallback should be marked unavailable until permission is granted

resultTriage.pass: All required stages pass; note whether actions used AX or fallback methods.
resultTriage.warn: Semantic path worked but returned warnings such as HID fallback, sparse AX tree, or unknown permission state.
resultTriage.skip: Expected for non-macOS and for action stages when --run-actions is omitted.
resultTriage.fail: Use docs/computer-use-macos-tcc-runbook.md to map the failing stage to TCC, daemon, target app, or fallback issues.
